menus.name: Holiday
menus.intro: Chef-crafted holiday catering for gatherings big and small. Orders accepted through New Year's. Portions, ingredients and vegetarian versions can be adjusted on request.

items.name: Cajun seared ahi tuna
items.description: Sweet Thai chili sauce, wasabi cream and orange ginger ponzu

items.name: Baked brie trilogy
items.description: Caramelized apple in puff pastry; fresh herb and garlic; blackberry and spiced pecan wrapped in phyllo. Served with toasted baguette

items.name: Roast chilled tenderloin
items.description: Horseradish cream, garlic and red onion jam, blue cheese crumbles and rainbow pepper confit, with toasted baguette

items.name: Grilled vegetable display
items.description: Balsamic glaze, basil pesto and whipped feta with honey and thyme

items.name: Deck the greens
items.description: Mixed greens with Honeycrisp apples, spiced pecans, goat cheese, tart cherries, black pepper and maple vinaigrette

items.name: Winter wedge salad
items.description: Iceberg wedge with roasted root vegetables, cherrywood bacon, pomegranate arils, caramelized red onion, blue cheese and spiced ranch

sections.title: Mains
sections.note: Each main comes with your choice of two sides.

items.name: Apple and raisin stuffed pork loin
Pan-seared rockfish
items.description: Celeriac and parsnip purée, sage brown butter

items.name: Cornbread stuffing with tart cherries and chestnuts
Cheesecake
items.description: Key lime with Oreo crust; lemon blueberry with pistachio crust; espresso with espresso mousse and ladyfinger crust. Individual, 6 inch (serves 6 to 8) or 10 inch (serves 12 to 16)

items.name: Mini dessert shooters
items.description: Tiramisu; white, dark and milk chocolate mousse; triple layer panna cotta (white chocolate, mango and raspberry); chocolate peanut butter mousse

items.name: Dessert bars
items.description: Pecan pie, peppermint brownie, lemon white chocolate with cranberries, eggnog cheesecake. Serves four
